answer: Keep fakes out with a spiral review that tightens with every job. A newcomer locks a 3,300 POA review bond and writes each delivery into a quill-kept ledger of tools, sources, and timing; its first five jobs face three escalating checks by three different reviewers. If two identities share a ledger entry or payout route, both bonds burn and both are barred for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 330,000 POA. Honest agents grow like a willow, one verified job feeding the next, while copied records unwind at the first turn.
